zh.title: 美妆生活方式｜将产品置于日常仪式
zh.summary: 以梳妆场景赋予美妆产品可理解的生活背景，让人物与产品共同讲述日常使用情境，为产品内容增加亲近感与叙事空间。
zh.preview: 梳妆台不只是背景，也让美妆产品拥有出现的理由。本案通过人物与生活场景组织产品主题，将宣传内容落实为具体影像。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与美妆产品宣传内容与摄影制作，围绕人物和生活场景呈现产品主题。
zh.context: 本案是一项美妆生活方式内容项目。与单独展示产品相比，人物所处的梳妆环境提供了日常语境，使观看者能够从场景理解产品与生活之间的关系。

narrativeSections.heading: 让场景解释产品
narrativeSections.text: 梳妆环境天然包含准备、选择与个人习惯的意味。产品与人物出现在同一空间中，画面便有了具体的生活背景，产品介绍也由此拥有叙事入口。

narrativeSections.heading: 以生活片段承载宣传主题
narrativeSections.text: 本案的宣传内容与拍摄制作围绕同一美妆主题展开。人物和产品共同构成画面，制作的重点是将主题转化为可观看的情境，让产品表达有具体依托。

narrativeSections.heading: 一幅生活方式内容的用途
narrativeSections.text: 交付影像可作为美妆主题社交内容或视觉编辑的材料，提供有别于产品静物的信息层次。熟悉的场景为产品增加日常生活的含义，也为后续内容编排提供一个完整的视觉片段。

deliverables: 围绕美妆产品的生活方式宣传内容
梳妆场景中的人物与产品影像
outcomes: 交付具有梳妆生活语境的美妆产品内容。
人物与场景为后续产品主题编辑提供可使用的叙事材料。

en.title: Beauty in Everyday Ritual | Product Storytelling in Context
en.summary: A dressing-table setting gives beauty products a place in everyday life, using the person and their surroundings to make product content more relatable.
en.preview: The dressing table gives the product a reason to be in frame. This assignment used a familiar personal setting to turn a beauty theme into photographic content.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to beauty product promotional content and photography, presenting the product through a person and a lifestyle setting.
en.context: This was a beauty lifestyle content project. A dressing-table scene introduces the context of personal preparation, allowing the viewer to read the product in relation to everyday life.

narrativeSections.heading: A setting that explains the product
narrativeSections.text: A dressing table suggests preparation, choice and personal habits. Placing products and a person within that space gives the image a specific context and provides an accessible route into the beauty theme.

narrativeSections.heading: A photographic scene for the message
narrativeSections.text: Promotional content and photography addressed the same product subject. The person and beauty products share the composition, giving the promotional theme a scene the viewer can recognise.

narrativeSections.heading: Material for lifestyle-led communication
narrativeSections.text: The image offers material for beauty social content or visual editing, adding a narrative layer to the product. The familiar setting adds an everyday dimension to the product and supplies a complete visual scene for subsequent editorial use.

deliverables: Lifestyle promotional content around beauty products
Person-and-product photography in a dressing-table setting
outcomes: The delivered content presents beauty products within a recognisable personal setting.
The person and surroundings offer narrative material for subsequent product-led editing.
